name: Free public dental care (NSW)
summary: Free dental care at NSW public clinics for adults holding a Health Care Card or other eligible concession card.
key: Eligible adults can receive free dental care from NSW public dental clinics.
who: Hold, or be listed as a dependant on, a Health Care Card, Pensioner Concession Card or Commonwealth Seniors Health Card
how: Call 1800 679 336 with your postcode, Medicare and concession card details ready

source.label: NSW Health: Public dental services - information for patients
